reasons: Deviation classification is supported: p0086 provides a 12-month Software conformance warranty (meeting the preferred duration) but states no remedy and omits services (professional/workmanlike), malicious-code and compliance-with-laws warranties, which the rule treats as insertable gaps.

The redline is additive and minimal — it leaves the existing conformance sentence untouched and appends only the missing warranties plus a repair/replace/re-perform remedy with a 30-day cure-then-refund backstop, tracking the model language and reaching the preferred position.

Comment is accurate, first-person plural, concise, cites the playbook gap (no stated remedy, no services/malicious code/compliance warranties) and offers the 90-day services fallback without lecturing.
Deterministic checks pass (operation applies; warranty period expressed in years, ≥ 90 days), and no 'AS IS' disclaimer issue is overstated in the rationale.
